summary: Server state of an active roll (dice roll with modifiers) that waits before it starts: the start request (Guid + byte, the same pair as esv::active_roll::StartRequestOneFrameComponent), two entity handles each followed by a list of 0x58-byte modifier entries, and a countdown. esv::active_roll::ModifierSystem::ProcessStartRequests creates it; ProcessWaitingActiveRollComponents (Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0xE44880; game ~bg3.exe+0x32D5CF0) finishes it at once when both lists are empty, otherwise subtracts the frame time from the countdown and, when it reaches 0, re-issues the request from +0/+0x10 (ActiveRollRequestData) and removes the component. Never seen alive. Registry total 80 (server row).
